svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: an AI agent's tool call goes through the agent-guard hook, a shell parser, the rule engine and a secret scanner, and ends as allow, ask or deny
svg.title: How agent-guard works
svg.text: Every tool call is parsed and checked locally before it runs

g.text: The agent wants to run rm -rf ~/
agent-guard parses what will really run, wrappers and all
Recursive delete of your home folder: denied
The reason goes back to the agent, which picks a safer command
rm -rf dist inside the project: allowed, no prompt
git reset --hard: sometimes right, so you decide
Writing apiKey: "sk-ant-…" into a source file: caught and denied
